versions.changelog:
Initial release enabling Google TV remote button remapping without root access.

- Remap app shortcut buttons (e.g., Netflix, YouTube) on Google TV Streamer remotes.
- Utilizes an accessibility service to capture and consume specific key events, launching any chosen app instead.
- Prevents the original (stock) app from launching, with no visible flash or redirection.
- Requires physical button press for verification—scripted input is not intercepted.
- No rooting or privileged access needed; instructions included for identifying keycodes, building, installing, and enabling the service.
